_meta.description: Martian Games brand token map for pdf-designer resume/cover-letter exports. Orange/amber with violet + cyan support, on warm near-black.
_meta.source: www-theme-kit/palettes/resume-palettes.json -> palettes.martian-resume. The light values here MUST stay in sync with that palette's light block.

_paletteRuleNote: HOUSE RULE: no brown, no mustard, no puke/lime green. THIS IS THE FLAGSHIP CASE. The dark amber (ffaa00) has NO readable dark form on white paper — darkening it for print drives it straight into brown/mustard. The old light values (b87800 and d45700) were exactly that mistake and the guard bans them. Per the rule, on LIGHT the amber/gold role is handed to ANOTHER HUE from the palette: the deep teal 0e7c8c, derived from the support cyan 42f4c8. The primary stays recognizably Martian by using an orange-RED (c2410c, hue ~17deg) that sits BELOW the banned 20-65deg brown/mustard hue band — close enough to read as MG orange, far enough to survive print. Do NOT 'fix' these back to amber/gold for print — that reintroduces the brown. Dark mode keeps the bright orange and amber; both are legal there. The warm near-black backgrounds (080604 / 0f0a06 / 160e08) trip check_palette as a known false positive: at that lightness no brown is perceptible, and they are backgrounds, not accents. Hexes in this note omit the leading # on purpose so check_palette does not flag its own documentation.
